impact_en: Rovera Travel Planner is an observed two-runtime student project. A Vite + React 19 frontend uses TanStack Router for route composition, HeroUI and Tailwind CSS for the interface, Leaflet for map interactions, and client-side trip, favorite, budget, and profile surfaces. A separate Express 5 backend exposes auth and user routes with JWT, bcrypt, MySQL access, and multer avatar uploads. The repository contains runnable source code, while its three architecture-document files are currently empty.
impact_tr: Rovera Travel Planner, gozlenen iki runtime'li bir ogrenci projesidir. Vite + React 19 frontend; route kompozisyonu icin TanStack Router, arayuz icin HeroUI ve Tailwind CSS, harita etkilesimleri icin Leaflet ve trip/favorite/budget/profile yuzeylerini kullanir. Ayri Express 5 backend JWT, bcrypt, MySQL ve multer avatar yuklemeleri ile auth ve user route'lari sunar. Repo calisan kaynak kodu icerir; uc mimari dokuman dosyasi ise su anda bostur.

adrs.title: Split frontend and API runtimes
adrs.context: The repository has a Vite frontend package and an Express backend package with separate start commands.
adrs.decision: Keep route rendering and API/auth concerns in separate runtime projects.
adrs.tradeoff: Local development needs both applications and an explicit API origin.

adrs.title: Use TanStack Router for file-based client routes
adrs.context: The frontend has a generated route tree and route files under src/routes.
adrs.decision: Compose authenticated and public travel flows through file-based client routing.
adrs.tradeoff: Generated route output must stay aligned with route files.

adrs.title: Use JWT plus bcrypt for account flows
adrs.context: The backend dependencies and auth middleware include jsonwebtoken and bcryptjs.
adrs.decision: Keep password hashing and bearer-token checks at the API boundary.
adrs.tradeoff: Token lifecycle, secret management, and refresh behavior remain operational responsibilities.
